subject: Unit price sweep: host comparative insights & target $/1M
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@heliocare.ai>, Olivia Chen <olivia@heliocare.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + open price questions after today's discovery

Thanks again for the time today — good to meet the HelioCare team. Short recap and a couple of clarifying questions so we can do an apples-to-apples price sweep.

Call summary (top-line)
- Primary workload: conversational assistant for clinical intake + triage; mix of short prompts (50-300 tokens) and longer system/context windows (1k-2k tokens) with heavy caching of patient context.
- Expected traffic: peak 25M tokens/day; expected steady-state ~10–12M tokens/day.
- Embeddings footprint: ~50M tokens/month for vector updates (not latency-sensitive).
- Timeline: pilot in 30–45 days, procurement decision ~60 days.

Clarifying asks (helps our benchmarking):
1) Please confirm your expected monthly aggregate token target (peak/avg) — I have ~750M tokens/month as a working number based on today's call.
2) Target monthly budget range for inference (not including infra/prof services).
3) Any hard SLA or latency requirements (95th pct < 200ms?) or is predictability more important than raw p95?

Attached is a raw pricing-grid (spreadsheet) we use for quick host comparisons — I'll fill in Redwood's suggested ranges once you confirm volumes/budget.

Next steps: once you confirm items above I'll send a short note with a target $/1M recommendation (hosted vs dedicated vs open-host fallbacks) and an estimated monthly cost for the pilot. Would love to lock a 30–60 day pilot with a small commit to validate latency and quality.

Attachments: pricing-grid.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Samir Patel <samir@heliocare.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@heliocare.ai>, procurement <procurement@heliocare.ai>
Date: 2026-10-16T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + open price questions after today's discovery

Thanks Kim — good summary and yes, the call was helpful. Confirming the numbers you used are in the right neighborhood:
- Monthly aggregate: ~750M tokens (that's peak-weighted; average is ~320–360M tokens/month).
- Budget range: looking to keep inference spend between $4k–$7k/month initially; if we can get predictable per-1M pricing with a clear path lower on commit, we can expand.
- SLA: 95th percentile latency target is ~250ms for the web assistant (so not ultra strict) — predictability during peaks is the main ask.

Two more data points:
- We're open to a small reserved commit for a pilot (30 days) if the math works — maybe a 300M-token commit?
- Procurement will need SOC2 + standard security questionnaire completed before PO.

Can you include a competitor comparison (OpenAI, Anthropic, two open-hosts) with the projected monthly bill for 750M tokens? That will help our CFO.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Product, HelioCare Analytics
samir@heliocare.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@heliocare.ai>, Olivia Chen <olivia@heliocare.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-17T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + open price questions after today's discovery

Thanks Samir — helpful context. Below is a concise host price sweep and an estimated monthly bill for the 750M token scenario, plus a recommended commercial path.

Host price sweep (recommended internal benchmarking figures) — $ per 1M tokens:
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity, 1: predictable throughput + KV caching): $3.8 / 1M
- Redwood Hosted (no reserve, enterprise rate): $5.5 / 1M
- Open-host A (quantized, lower latency variance, no SLA): $4.5 / 1M
- OpenAI (hosted, standard gen model): $6.8 / 1M
- Anthropic (hosted): $7.2 / 1M

Estimated monthly spend at 750M tokens (750 units of 1M):
- Redwood Dedicated: 750 * $3.8 = $2,850
- Redwood Hosted: 750 * $5.5 = $4,125
- Open-host A: 750 * $4.5 = $3,375
- OpenAI: 750 * $6.8 = $5,100
- Anthropic: 750 * $7.2 = $5,400

Notes and caveats:
- These are illustrative list/benchmark numbers to help procurement. Actuals vary by sequence-length mix, streaming vs non-streaming, and whether KV caching/reuse applies. Your workload (heavy prefix reuse + embeddings + batching) will materially lower per-token bill when using Dedicated + caching.
- Open-host A is low-cost but lacks enterprise SLA and has higher tail-latency risk; good for non-critical background tasks.
- Redwood Dedicated pricing above assumes a moderate commit; we can structure a pilot with a 300M token short-term commit to get you into the Dedicated tier for the pilot window.

Suggested commercial proposal for HelioCare pilot
1) 30–45 day pilot on Redwood Dedicated with a 300M token commit (pilot price = $3.8 / 1M for usage covered by commit).
2) Run full telemetry + evals against your prompt set during pilot; we will provide a latency SLO report and cost dashboard.
3) If pilot shows expected cost/latency gains, convert to a 12-month reserved capacity with stepped discounts at higher commits.

Attachments: redwood-sow-draft.pdf, pricing-grid.xlsx

Next steps
- If that looks OK, can we schedule a 30-minute commercial review with your procurement and finance this week?
- I will also kick off SOC2 + security questionnaire handoff to your security contact after you confirm procurement timeline.

If helpful I can also run a 2-up pricing slide (Redwood vs OpenAI vs Anthropic vs Open-host A) and include estimated tail-risk notes for your CFO.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
